scope: Local source and real-Chromium reproduction only. No hosted, SSH, provider, credential, Root or business-write activity.

hosted_acceptance.note: Original Root 43215810588 / a7ff971 / 352cb886 FE gate reported Fetch.continueRequest Invalid InterceptionId; hosted causation is not proven here. Candidate is not claimed accepted; redeploy and QA remain with the original STRAT Human/Ops owner.

local_root_cause: Chromium can deliver Fetch.requestPaused before Network.requestWillBeSent for the same network id (observed locally for XHR /held, e.g. network id 7152.2, in the full-suite run). The helper looked up the network entry only at pause time, found none, and therefore had no lifecycle binding or pre-command sample; a later real navigation-cancelled Invalid InterceptionId could not be proven and was recorded as a transport failure. Historical hosted ordering is unmeasured (unknown).
fix: On requestPaused without a network entry, register an unbound placeholder under the network id; the later requestWillBeSent binds frame/loader onto that same object. Proof rules are unchanged (same-id cancellation timestamped no later than the pre-command Performance sample plus document replacement, same-document navigation or detach). An unbound request never gains proof and still fails closed. No global swallow, no assertHealthy removal, no timeout/SLA change.

frame_detach_addendum.root_cause: For a real iframe removal Chromium emits Network.loadingFailed(canceled) BEFORE Page.frameDetached for the same network id. The helper's frameDetached handler required !request.failed, and requestfailed treated the detached-frame ERR_ABORTED as live, so detach proof was discarded.
frame_detach_addendum.fix: frameDetached now marks detached for same-frame interceptions that have not yet had their pre-command Performance sample (request.sampled) and are not closed; a detach observed after the sample/command cannot excuse a live failure. requestfailed also accepts ERR_ABORTED when the request's frame is detached (checked after the existing 25ms delay). Same-id canceledAt<=pre-command sample rule unchanged; no blanket suppression.
frame_detach_addendum.heldSample_scope: Test harness clears heldSample when the held continuation begins so a later navigation sample is not held.
new_tests: iframe removal cancelling a held interception settles healthy (x3, positive)
live abort then later iframe removal stays actionable (negative: Invalid InterceptionId and ERR_ABORTED retained)
frame_detach_addendum.commands: PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=<cache> PANTHEON_FE_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:1 npx playwright test e2e/hosted-bff-streaming-transport.spec.ts [--grep 'iframe removal']
frame_detach_addendum.old_trace: loadingFailed(canceled, same network id) -> frameDetached -> Performance sample -> Fetch.continueRequest Invalid InterceptionId; assertHealthy retained GET /held net::ERR_ABORTED and CDP InvalidId

observed_abort_then_detach_addendum.review_finding: P1 on 80d28fb8: detach arriving before the sample marked a previously observed live ERR_ABORTED failure as detach-caused, and requestfailed excused it via isDetached() after its 25ms delay; real Chromium repro (fixture review observed live abort then immediate detach, x3) left transport.errors=[] and assertHealthy passing.
observed_abort_then_detach_addendum.measured_event_order: Detach teardown: Page.frameSubtreeWillBeDetached -> Network.loadingFailed(canceled) -> Page.frameDetached. Live JS abort then later removal: Network.loadingFailed(canceled) -> frameSubtreeWillBeDetached -> frameDetached. Hosted ordering remains unmeasured (unknown).
observed_abort_then_detach_addendum.fix: Detach evidence is now causal: a cancellation is detach-caused only if Page.frameSubtreeWillBeDetached for the request's frame (or an ancestor) preceded its Network.loadingFailed. The arrival-order `sampled` gate and the post-delay req.frame().isDetached() excuse are removed; requestfailed consumes a per-url detach-cancel record instead. Same-id canceledAt<=pre-command-sample rule, navigation/same-document proofs and no-global-swallow unchanged.
observed_abort_then_detach_addendum.new_test: observed live abort then immediate iframe removal before sample stays actionable (x3, real Chromium; asserts ERR_ABORTED retained and Invalid InterceptionId thrown)
observed_abort_then_detach_addendum.hosted: No hosted acceptance, credentials or deploy activity.

same_url_frame_credit_addendum.root_cause: detachCancelled credits were keyed only by URL; a live aborted request in the main frame (same URL as a request in a detached iframe) consumed the iframe's detach credit, and the iframe's own failure was excused by changed generation, hiding the live ERR_ABORTED.
same_url_frame_credit_addendum.fix: requestfailed may consume a detach credit only when the failed Playwright request's own frame isDetached(); a live frame's abort never consumes another frame's credit.
same_url_frame_credit_addendum.new_test: same-URL frame detach credit cannot excuse a live abort in another frame (negative, x3, real Chromium, nothing synthesized)

exit_codes.full_spec: 25 passed; 1 failed: pre-existing 'exact aa17 accept-management-hosted-production' timing test, which loads historical aa17 source via git and does not exercise the modified helper

exact_request_causal_addendum.review_finding: P1 on 28b18566: helper still consumed a URL-keyed detach credit using req.frame().isDetached() after the 25ms delay; live iframe A aborted before any detach, then B's genuine teardown credit plus A's later own removal excused A (2/3 runs false-green).
exact_request_causal_addendum.fix: Detach credits and URL/frame matching removed. A BFF ERR_ABORTED is judged in Network.loadingFailed on that exact network id's own record: underDetach captured at the failure instant, same-document flag, per-frame navigation count since request start (Page.frameNavigated), or page/context closure. Playwright requestfailed only handles non-ABORTED failures, and ERR_ABORTED beyond the native per-URL count (no CDP record) falls back to closure/frame generation only. No new framework, timeout or SLA.
exact_request_causal_addendum.new_test: a live frame abort stays actionable when a later own detach follows another frame's genuine teardown (real Chromium, two iframes, x5)
exact_request_causal_addendum.hosted: No hosted acceptance, credentials or deploy; hosted cause remains unknown.

failure_time_closure_addendum.finding: P1 at c0e8bf8b1: ERR_ABORTED judged 25ms later against future closed/page.isClosed or any later frameNavigated, so a live abort confirmed by Network.loadingFailed and requestfailed became healthy after later page.close/navigation.
failure_time_closure_addendum.fix: Closure is captured at the failure instant; a trailing frameNavigated excuses only if a replacing document navigation (navigationLoader != request loaderId) was already in flight at failure.

failure_time_closure_addendum.after: page-close and navigation negatives 6/6 pass; full streaming suite 27/27 pass before negatives appended; strict-browser-auth contract 7/7 pass
